stories.headline: Hoor Al Qasimi Named Curator of 2028 Venice Biennale
stories.summary: Sheikha Hoor Al Qasimi has been named curator of the 2028 Venice Biennale, according to ARTnews.com. The board of La Biennale di Venezia says it chose her at a November 20 meeting on the recommendation of its president, Pietrangelo Buttafuoco.

stories.headline: Hoor Al Qasimi to curate 2028 Venice Biennale
stories.summary: The Art Newspaper reports that Hoor Al Qasimi, director of the Sharjah Art Foundation and the Sharjah Biennial, has been appointed curator of the 62nd International Art Exhibition. The post gives no further details on the appointment.

sources.author: James Imam

stories.headline: City Backs Metcalfe Lofts Housing Project
stories.summary: The Milwaukee Common Council has approved $1.1 million toward turning a former factory into affordable housing, according to Urban Milwaukee. The outlet reports the project still faces a complicated financing path.

stories.headline: Music groups back charter on dementia access
stories.summary: Universal, Warner and the BPI are backing a charter aimed at barriers that keep people with dementia from accessing music, according to Music Business Worldwide. The outlet reports that only three in ten older family caregivers can stream music with the person they care for, citing Music for Dementia.

stories.headline: PostgreSQL packaged as a single executable
stories.summary: A project called Minipg aims to run PostgreSQL, a database system, as one executable file, according to a post on Hacker News. The poster shares a link to the project page but offers no further details.
